title: 第1189章 准备献祭亲闺女第1188章 叶玄的选择
slug: 重生魔帝开局骗女帝下界双修
content_zh:
殿内。
两位仙盟至尊元老相视一笑。
都是有些意味深长。
“此次过后，我们或许可以在巅峰相见！”
北冥仙尊心情大好。
“本座帝路已断，倒是没有奢望了。”
“祝道兄好运。”叶玄拱了拱手道。
如今他到手了三份三光神水，已经是稳坐钓鱼台了。
没错，北冥直接就先把报酬给了他。
毕竟这种事情可是没办法作假的，而且也不担心对方反悔。
那种代价，叶玄他承受不起，镇妖殿也承受不住！
他代表的可不仅仅是他自己。
甚至还有炎家。
甚至是还有天神殿，两大帝族势力！
所有的对手都明白，所有对云殿下有想法的存在都清楚。
这一次妖域的窗口期，就是最后的机会了。
而一旦让对方破境仙皇，那就再也没有丝毫的机会！
届时，他们某些人的下场已经可以注定了。
毕竟大道争锋，从来不是请客吃饭，是要死人的。
“计划实施的时候，我会通知你。”

北冥仙尊说着，转身就要离开，他也要去准备充分。
各种阵法材料甚至是地点选择等等，都需要小心谨慎的准备。
走在半途，北冥的身形忽然一顿。
“道兄你这是分身吧？”他忽然冷不丁的问道。
叶玄点了点头。
“本体正在闭关。”他面色平静的说道。
“紫霄道友那边，找你可是有什么事情？”北冥很是直接的问道。
毕竟两人现在也算是一条船上的了。
“妖域物资丰富。”叶玄只是淡淡说道。
“呵呵....”北冥冷笑了两声。
他什么也没有说。
既然是代表仙盟来谈生意的，那他自然也没什么好说的。
而且现在叶玄已经答应了他的合作。
所以也没有什么好担心的。
content_en:
Inside the palace.
The two supreme elders of the Immortal Alliance looked at each other and smiled.
They are all somewhat meaningful.
"After this, maybe we can meet at the top!"
Immortal Lord Beiming was in a good mood.
"My path to the throne is cut off, so I have no extravagant hopes."
"I wish you good luck, Brother Dao." Ye Xuan cupped his hands and said.
Now that he has obtained three copies of the Sanguang Divine Water, he is already firmly on the Diaoyutai.
That's right, Beiming gave him the reward directly.
After all, there is no way to fake this kind of thing, and there is no need to worry about the other party going back on his word.
Ye Xuan couldn't bear that kind of price, and neither could the Demon Suppressing Palace!
He represents more than just himself.
There is even the Yan family.
There are even two major imperial clan forces, the Celestial Temple!
All opponents know it, and everyone who has thoughts about His Highness Yun knows it.
This window period of the Demon Realm is the last chance.
And once the opponent breaks through to the Immortal Emperor, there will no longer be the slightest chance!
By then, the fate of some of them will have been determined.
After all, fighting on the great road is never about treating guests to dinner, it is about killing people.
"I will inform you when the plan is implemented."
Beiming Immortal Lord said, turning around to leave, he also wanted to be fully prepared.
Various formation materials and even location selection, etc., all require careful preparation.
Halfway through the walk, Beiming's figure suddenly paused.
"Brother Dao, are you a clone?" He asked suddenly and abruptly.
Ye Xuan nodded.
"The main body is in retreat." He said calmly.
"Fellow Taoist Zixiao, what business do you have?" Bei Ming asked directly.
After all, the two of them are now in the same boat.
"The Demon Realm is rich in materials." Ye Xuan just said lightly.
"Haha..." Beiming sneered twice.
He said nothing.
Since he was here to discuss business on behalf of the Immortal Alliance, he naturally had nothing to say.
And now Ye Xuan has agreed to his cooperation.
So there is nothing to worry about.
